### `design-control-loop` — deferred

*humanlayer_skills · `3c26291` · ruled in round-003-humanlayer-skills*

Complement to our execution engine at a different timescale (scheduled, PR-granular, human-steered vs in-session, plan-granular, in-loop review). Agrees with every recorded orchestration principle (no long-lived thread, fresh worker + packet, state outside the session, no loops in the stage graph); conflicts only with shipped mechanics (bypassPermissions runner, git add -A, GHA+Bun+gh dependency, flat-file state instead of bd). Adds ideas we lack: set point + sensor (a loop that converges), dampener, open-PR throughput bound, memory-after-selection with /iterate write-back, local-first gate. Deferred until a recurring-maintenance need exists in a user repo; then borrow the vocabulary and steering channel on a bd + cron/claude -p host, and consider it as a second graph type for cr-o85.

**Deliberately dropped:**

- GitHub Actions workflow template
- agent-iteration.ts Bun helper
- agent-runner recipes with bypassPermissions
- git add -A iterate path
- workflow-summary description
